$comment: Run O1 lane K1 batch b9: series data for Kagurabachi (tier C, manga only), built from the pinned Wikipedia revision 1380968841 (read as raw wikitext, including the volume tables and the list of chapters not yet collected), Wikidata Q122713274 and the official Weekly Shonen Jump page (read directly: title, author 外薗 健, magazine, publisher, issue 42 of 2023, 12 volumes). The anime (announced for April 2027) is not stored. Arcs: no allowed source names story arcs, so the five arcs follow the Wikipedia volume summaries and chapter lists, with borders at volume edges: Cloud Gouger (volumes 1 and 2, chapters 1 to 18), Rakuzaichi (volumes 3 to 5, chapters 19 to 46), Samura and the Sword Bearers (volumes 6 to 8, chapters 47 to 74), Kamunabi Headquarters (volumes 9 to 12, chapters 75 to 113) and the chapters not yet in volumes (from 114, ongoing, no end stored). Volume 9 opens with the Kyoto duel before the headquarters attack, so the 74/75 border is approximate. Character names and kanji come from the Nihongo templates of the character list; debut arcs follow the first volume summary that names the character. Hishaku members are named in chapter 1 context but Yura is first met in volume 4, hence arc 2. Chapter count is not stored (the uncollected list reaches 135 but the page is still moving). Series start: Wikipedia says September 19, 2023, Wikidata September 18, the official page says issue 42 of 2023, so only September 2023 is stated. Themes: none, no anime has aired.

characters.name: Chihiro Rokuhira
characters.description: A young swordsmith's son who wields the Enchanted Blade Enten to avenge his father.

characters.name: Togo Shiba
characters.description: A teleporting sorcerer and family friend who helps Chihiro on his quest.

characters.name: Char Kyonagi
characters.description: An orphan from the Kyonagi clan, known for strong regenerative healing.

characters.name: Soshiro Azami
characters.description: A government sorcerer of the Kamunabi and an old ally of Chihiro's father.

characters.name: Genichi Sojo
characters.description: A crime boss and weapons dealer who holds a stolen Enchanted Blade.

characters.name: Kunishige Rokuhira
characters.description: The legendary swordsmith who forged the Enchanted Blades.

characters.name: Hakuri Sazanami
characters.description: A disowned member of the Sazanami clan who allies with Chihiro.

characters.name: Hiyuki Kagari
characters.description: A Kamunabi operative whose sorcery rivals the Enchanted Blades.

characters.name: Yura
characters.description: The leader of the Hishaku, the sorcerer group that murdered Kunishige.

characters.name: Iori Samura
characters.description: The daughter of a sword bearer, raised around swordsmanship.

characters.name: Seiichi Samura
characters.description: A blind master of the Tobimune blade and the Iai White Purity Style.

characters.name: Akemura Soga
characters.description: A feared sorcerer known as the Sword Master, wielder of the Magatsumi blade.
